description: Search read-only global user memory and current-project memory. Results are durable preferences or project facts, not current-file verification. Use recall_context for archived tool output and historical messages.

propertyDescriptions.query: A concise query describing the durable fact or preference to retrieve.
propertyDescriptions.scope: all (default), global user memory, or current-project memory. The model cannot select another project.
propertyDescriptions.includeInactive: Include superseded and expired audit-history entries. Leave false for ordinary work.

guidance: Use read_memory for global user and current-project long-term memory. Search before revise, forget, or move so write_memory receives an ID returned in the same turn. Each result names its scope. Do not treat a remembered fact as proof of the current checkout; inspect current files or run validation when freshness matters. Use search_context and recall_context for current-thread history.
